page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, no margins with text. Heading at top centre (two lines, title of a book list), then four numbered entries in one column, the last entry's number at the lower right as catchword. No page number, no running head.

main_text.l: Libri editi in Typographia S. Con-
I.[?] DE ætate, & interstitijs in Collatione Ordinum etiam
apud Græcos seruandis, ad Cardinalem FRANCI-
ALLATII Ode Pindarica, & Epigrammata vii. Græca
LARIO Monachus, De Processione Spiritus sancti a Patre, &
Refutatio Epistolæ scriptæ ab Armenorum Principe, qua
nabatur, & alijs. Tomus primus. LEO ALLATIVS nunc
primum e tenebris eruit, & Latine vertit, ad Car-
nicensi in numerum Sanctorum a nonnullis Græcis
adscito Græcorum[?] sententiæ, nec non GREGORII ACINDYNI,
III. ORTHODOXAE GRAECIAE Scriptores, IOANNES VECCVS
Ecclesiæ, MAXIMVS CHRYSOBERGA De Processione Spiritus sancti, & alijs. ad
nunc primum e tenebris eruit, & Latine vertit.

page.notes: The numeral of the first entry is printed in a larger italic form and is read here as I, marked [?]. The word after "adscito" is read as Græcorum; the scan is faint and it may read Gracorum, marked [?]. The large initial D of entry I is joined to "E ætate". The ornament between the heading and entry I is left out.
